$comment: Settings of the desktop shell (apps/desktop, ADR-0004). Versioned config, no constants in code.

claude.$comment: Deep link that brings Claude Desktop to the front. Only the listed schemes may be opened. Not verified against a Claude Desktop install yet: if opening fails, the app says so and keeps the start sentence on the clipboard.
claude.startSentence: Start Astrolabe session {code}. Call forge_attach with this code and work through all tasks with forge_submit and forge_next until the run is done. Keep going without waiting for me unless the app needs me.

economy.$comment: Market prices (poe.ninja) for crafting and start costs. Off = no prices, crafting costs stay uncalibrated. Provider, endpoints and limits are in config/economy.

citations.$comment: Hosts a citation link in a guide may open in the browser (exact host or subdomain). The same list is the research allowlist in config/agents/research.json.

dataSync.$comment: New patches are data releases (F-01): the app looks for them on GitHub Releases, verifies and installs them next to the bundled one. Pre-releases count while 1.0 data is still being proven.
